channel.title: zyekh.com — Technical Articles & Security Research
channel.description: Technical articles, Linux VPS hardening blueprints, eBPF security research, and minimalist server architecture by Zyekh Abdul Qadir Jailani.

item.title: Comprehensive Linux VPS Hardening Blueprint for 2026
item.description: Production-grade security blueprint for Debian and Ubuntu Linux servers: SSH Ed25519 key enforcement, sysctl kernel flags, UFW rate limiting, Fail2Ban, and auditd event monitoring.

item.title: Understanding eBPF for Real-Time Linux Security Monitoring
item.description: Technical guide on Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) tracing, kernel probe instrumentation, and low-overhead security monitoring in modern Linux systems.

item.title: Implementing Strict Content Security Policy (CSP) & Security Headers
item.description: Step-by-step technical guide for configuring strict Content Security Policy (CSP), HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), and defense-in-depth headers.

item.title: Why Minimalist Static Hosting Outperforms Monolithic Frameworks for Security
item.description: Architectural breakdown of zero-dependency static site hosting, pure CSS design systems, and eliminating attack surfaces by discarding heavy frameworks.
